claim: Patchline ships partial-identification bounds giving worst-case effect intervals under minimal assumptions. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the partial-identification bounds claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make partial-identification-bounds-gate`.
